card.name: Square meters in body surface area
card.fires_on: The 'm' or '2' of m² (square meters) right after a decimal number, mostly in body surface area or kidney-function units such as 1.73 m². Occasionally on 'meter' or 'squared' in the same setting.

modes.label: m after decimal
modes.description: The letter m just after a number like 0.76 or 1.73, before the superscript 2.

modes.label: Superscript 2 of m²
modes.description: The 2 following 'm' in a body surface area threshold or eGFR unit.

modes.label: Spelled-out meter
modes.description: The word 'meter' or 'squared' when the unit is written out.
